description: P6: shared pure reducers for Ludo, Tic-Tac-Toe, RPS with tests first, server handlers with per-recipient redaction, and pastel UIs. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Do plan.md tasks P6-1 through P6-4 in order (design.md section 12).
THREE_SIXES_FORFEIT is the single switch; mention the house rule in games help text (review note 6).
acceptance_criteria: All reducer tests pass (TTT lines/draw, RPS 27 triples, Ludo rules, parseGameAction garbage)
Smoke: illegal and garbage game actions rejected without state change; RPS picks hidden from other clients before reveal
verification: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
npm --prefix signaling-server test; npm --prefix signaling-server run build
background server + npm --prefix signaling-server run smoke
findings: Pure reducers (ludo, tictactoe, rps) in shared/games with tests; parseGameAction shapes; server game:open/close/action handlers with per-recipient redaction (Room.gameState + viewGame), server rng, Ludo turn-skip sweep, leave/forfeit; Games tab UI (picker, Ludo SVG board, dice, seats, TTT, RPS, winner banners, help incl. three-sixes house rule). Added LudoState.lastRoll (dice value kept after auto-pass) and optional Result.code='forbidden'. Gate: typecheck, lint, root tests (249), build, server typecheck/tests (103)/build, smoke 80/80 all green.
